( Liberty Global ), a dynamic team of operators and investors generating and delivering long-term shareholder value through the strategic management of three complementary platforms: Liberty Telecom, Liberty Growth and Liberty Services. These brands deliver market-leading connectivity and entertainment products through next-generation networks, providing approximately 80 million fixed and mobile connections at December 31, 2025. We are pursuing strategies in each market to drive commercial momentum, finance and monetize network infrastructure and pursue accretive transactions that deliver value to our shareholders.
